## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the evidence behind any protocol change.

## Validation

- [ ] `dotnet build` succeeds with zero warnings.
- [ ] Protocol tests pass.
- [ ] No proprietary ASUS/ENE binary or copied implementation code is included.
- [ ] Hardware testing, if performed, started conservatively and restored the original PWM values.
- [ ] Documentation and tested firmware notes are updated where relevant.
